annotation.justification: The clause simply recommends that implementations with adaptive time thresholds may choose to start with smaller initial reordering thresholds to reduce recovery latency. It does not contain any conflicting or under‑specified normative requirements that would allow two materially different implementation behaviours. Therefore it is not ambiguous.
